purpose: Account of improving AI-generated interface design

required_facts.fact: One-shot designs often repeat grids, crowded headers and columns.
The author's early sites used Bootstrap.
A Codex redesign of the course platform was initially poor.
GPT Image mockups set a better direction.
GitHub Primer became the documented design system.
The process includes mockups, implementation and iterative review.
Pocket Shell used the same mockup approach.

author_attribution: Describe Alexey's own design experiments and preserve his qualified assessment.
